about: One row per skill (5 per hero). slot: primary=M1 gun, secondary=M2 (Deadlock ability 1), utility=Shift (ability 2), special=R (a new move from a Deadlock item, melee or ability, on a normal cooldown), equipment=Q (the hero's Deadlock ultimate as a RoR2 equipment: every hero starts holding their own, anyone can find it wherever the Preon Accumulator can drop; design/equipment.json). Numbers are RoR2-scale: damagePct is % of the body's damage stat (RoR2 convention), cooldowns are RoR2 seconds. deadlock* columns hold the source values read from the player's Deadlock scripts/abilities.vdata (ClientVersion 6774) so every conversion is traceable. kind picks the generic EntityState that implements the row. Unused numeric params are 0, unused refs are "none" (filled on purpose, not missing). Balance targets: sustained primary DPS 240-600 %/s (Commando Double Tap ~ 400 %/s incl. downtime); secondaries 2-15 s; utilities 4-12 s; specials 4-30 s; equipment ults 120 s cooldown and at least 6000 % per enemy (Preon Accumulator scaled from 140 s to 120 s; no upper limit: the ults are pickups any survivor can carry and are left out of balance). buffStacks: stacks of buff a hit adds (Phantom Strike's Fixation, Torment Pulse's Afterburn build-up; Flame Dash: the gun's buff each fire pocket adds every interval), 0 = the usual one. knockback: dashes and punches knock enemies away at this many m/s (0 = none). minDuration: hold skills (the Seismic Impact hover) last at least this long on a tap and at most duration while held; 0 otherwise. vfx: our own Unity-built visual for the skill (an effects row of kind custom), or none. extra: a second RoR2 object the kind spawns (an effects row: the Warbanner ward of Thunderhead), a behaviour flag (pierce: the projectile flies through every enemy in its line; shockwave: the punch also hits every enemy in a cone of length 2x radius and half-angle spreadDeg), or none. expect: what the skill must measurably do, checked in test mode (enemy_damage, enemy_stun, enemy_burn, enemy_debuff:<buff>, self_buff:<buff>, self_heal, self_move, self_cloak). pattern: a fixed pellet pattern instead of random spread (krill: Deadlock's centre pellet and a triangle of three, corners spreadDeg out), or none. cooldownOnEnd: the cooldown starts when the move ends (Dust Devil), not when it starts. debuff: a second buff the move gives (Burrow's pop-out slow on enemies; Tag Team's max-health trophies on the thrower, per kill), or none. bossMult: how much of the move's control a boss (champion) gets: a pull's strength, a disarm's length, 0 = no knock-up on bosses; for Tag Team the max-health stacks a boss kill gives. reach: a second distance (Tag Team's hop range, the punch's reach). splashPct: damage around the main target (Tag Team's landing splash, within radius). meleePct / meleeRate: on a gun row, the punch M1 throws instead of firing while a buff with melee=true is on (Mo while Krill is away: damage per punch, punches per second). meleeKnock: the punch throws each enemy it hits away from the hero at this many m/s (mass-scaled, bosses at a quarter), 0 = none. On cone_wave, minDuration is the wind-up before the wave leaves (the cone is shown on the ground meanwhile). gravity: extra downward pull on a gun projectile (m/s2; gun_goo blobs drop about 1 m at 30 m). falloffStart/falloffEnd/falloffMinPct: a projectile's damage falls linearly from 100% at falloffStart metres travelled to falloffMinPct % at falloffEnd and stays there. ammoCost: the move costs that many rounds of the gun's magazine instead of a cooldown (lob_ammo: Splatter); with fewer left it still fires, its radius scaled by rounds/ammoCost. puddleMult: the radius is multiplied by this when the move lands on a goo puddle (Puddle Punch). launchHeight: allies and the hero standing in the move are thrown this many metres up (a bounce pad), no fall damage on that landing. damageMinPct: the smallest damage of a move that scales with speed (Goo Ball: damageMinPct at a crawl, damagePct at top speed). For lob_ammo, reach / chainCount / interval are the puddle's radius, seconds and tick, and debuff the buff it gives allies inside (Slick). puddleAmmo: rounds a goo puddle of this row gives its owner the first time the owner stands in it (on top of the magazine, up to the magazine plus this; a reload under way is called off), 0 = none. puddleShrink: seconds the puddle takes to draw in to nothing after its chainCount seconds whole (its reach shrinks with it), 0 = it just ends.

rows.name: Twin SMGs
rows.description: Fire Haze's SMGs for <style=cIsDamage>55% damage</style> per bullet. Every hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Fixation</style> on the target (<style=cIsDamage>critical hits stack 3</style>). 25-round magazine.

rows.name: Sleep Dagger
rows.description: Throw a dagger that <style=cIsUtility>pierces</style> every enemy in a line for <style=cIsDamage>500% damage</style> and puts them to <style=cIsUtility>sleep</style> (stunned) for 4s. Doesn't break Smoke Bomb.

rows.name: Smoke Bomb
rows.description: Vanish into smoke: become <style=cIsUtility>invisible</style> (enemies lose track of you and can't target you) and gain <style=cIsUtility>+50% movement speed</style> for 5s. Firing your guns reveals you.

rows.name: Phantom Strike
rows.description: Blink behind the enemy you aim at (up to 30m away) and cut it with <style=cIsDamage>3 dagger slashes for 250% damage</style> each, hitting <style=cIsDamage>every enemy within 5m</style> of it. Every slash adds <style=cIsUtility>5 Fixation</style>. No target, no cast.

rows.name: Bullet Dance
rows.description: Spin for 5s, firing at <style=cIsDamage>every enemy</style> within 25m at once for <style=cIsDamage>113% damage</style> 12 times a second (about <style=cIsDamage>6800%</style> to each enemy), with a <style=cIsUtility>30% chance to evade</style> attacks.

rows.name: Shotgun
rows.description: Blast 9 pellets for <style=cIsDamage>9x52% damage</style>. 9-shell magazine.

rows.name: Siphon Life
rows.description: For 8s, tether up to <style=cIsUtility>3 enemies within 25m</style> like a Mired Urn, draining them for <style=cIsDamage>450% damage per second</style> each and <style=cIsHealing>healing for all of it</style>.

rows.name: Shoulder Charge
rows.description: Charge forward for up to 3s. Every enemy you run into takes <style=cIsDamage>1600% damage</style>, is <style=cIsUtility>knocked aside</style> out of your path and <style=cIsUtility>stunned</style> for 1s.

rows.name: Haymaker
rows.description: Lock onto the enemy you aim at within 20m (even one in the air) and rush straight at it into a heavy punch for <style=cIsDamage>2400% damage</style>. Its <style=cIsDamage>shockwave</style> hits every enemy in a 6m cone behind it for the same damage and <style=cIsUtility>knocks them flying</style>. No target, no cast.

rows.name: Seismic Impact
rows.description: Leap into the air and hover for up to 3s while you pick a spot within 40m, then <style=cIsUtility>fire (Left Click)</style> to crash down for <style=cIsDamage>6800% damage</style> in an 18m radius, <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> enemies for 1.6s. You can be hit while you hover.

rows.name: Shock Rifle
rows.description: Fire a 3-round burst for <style=cIsDamage>3x60% damage</style>. Hits build <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>. 29-round magazine.

rows.name: Lightning Ball
rows.description: Hurl a slow ball of lightning that <style=cIsUtility>flies through enemies</style> and <style=cIsUtility>bounces off walls and floors</style>, shocking everything within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>240% damage per second</style> for 5s. Every shock builds <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>.

rows.name: Static Charge
rows.description: Plant a static charge on the enemy (or spot) you aim at. After 1.5s it discharges for <style=cIsDamage>450% damage</style> to everything within 8m and <style=cIsUtility>stuns</style> them for 0.9s.

rows.name: Power Surge
rows.description: For 8s, every Shock Rifle burst <style=cIsDamage>arcs Tesla lightning</style> from the target to up to 4 more enemies within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>60% damage</style> each, building <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>. +40% movement speed.

rows.name: Thunderhead
rows.description: Call a storm on the spot where you stand: for 10s, lightning strikes up to 4 enemies inside its 20m radius every 0.4s for <style=cIsDamage>272% damage</style> (<style=cIsDamage>6800%</style> per enemy), and allies inside get a <style=cIsUtility>Warbanner</style> (+30% attack and movement speed).

rows.name: Flame Gun
rows.description: Fire for <style=cIsDamage>75% damage</style> per bullet. Hits build <style=cIsDamage>Afterburn</style>; at full build-up the target <style=cIsDamage>burns</style>. 27-round magazine.

rows.name: Napalm
rows.description: Hold a flask of napalm (a marker shows where it will land), then <style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style> to lob it; it bursts in a 5m splash for <style=cIsDamage>300% damage</style>. Enemies hit are <style=cIsUtility>slowed by 28%</style> for 4s and take <style=cIsDamage>+16% damage</style> from you for 8s. 2 charges.

rows.name: Flame Dash
rows.description: Run at high speed for <style=cIsUtility>5s</style> with <style=cIsUtility>50% slow resistance</style>, <style=cIsUtility>knocking aside</style> enemies you run into. You leave <style=cIsDamage>pockets of fire</style> that burn for 5s; every 0.5s each enemy inside builds <style=cIsDamage>3 Afterburn</style>, and overlapping pockets stack.

rows.name: Torment Pulse
rows.description: For 6s, rings of fire pulse out of you every 0.5s, burning everything within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>50% damage</style> and adding <style=cIsUtility>2 Afterburn</style> build-up.

rows.name: Concussive Combustion
rows.description: Become a bomb: after 3s you explode for <style=cIsDamage>6800% damage</style> to everything within 18m, <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> enemies for 2s. Each kill <style=cIsHealing>heals you for 10%</style> of your health. You can move while it builds.

rows.name: Yellow Canary
rows.description: Krill fires 4 pellets in a fixed triangle for <style=cIsDamage>4x40% damage</style>. 20-shot magazine. While Krill is away (Tag Team), Mo goes into a <style=cIsDamage>Frenzy</style>: double speed and punches for <style=cIsDamage>600%</style> that knock monsters flying.

rows.name: Sand Blast
rows.description: Wind up, then spray a cone of sand 20m out for <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style> to everything it passes, throwing monsters back. Hit monsters are <style=cIsUtility>Sanded</style>: they can't attack for 2s (1s for bosses) and are slowed 30%. The cone shows on the ground as he winds up. Works while burrowed.

rows.name: Burrow
rows.description: Dig underground for up to 8s, moving <style=cIsUtility>three times as fast</style> with <style=cIsHealing>+100 armor</style>. Burst out (Shift or Jump, or after 8s) in a spin that hits everything within 8m <style=cIsDamage>3 times for 500%</style>, knocks monsters up and slows them 50%. Press Q underground to burst straight into Dust Devil.

rows.name: Tag Team
rows.description: Throw Krill at the enemy you aim at (40m). For 8s he leaps from enemy to enemy every 0.5s, each landing dealing <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style>, <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> to everything within 4m, and <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> for 1s. Mo goes into a Frenzy meanwhile. No target, no throw.

rows.name: Dust Devil
rows.description: Spin into a sand tornado for 5s, <style=cIsUtility>pulling in</style> every enemy within 16m and hitting everything within 8m for <style=cIsDamage>450% four times a second</style>. Keep walking and jumping while it spins. Any survivor holding it spins.

rows.name: Deep Sea Interpreter
rows.description: Fire blobs of goo for <style=cIsDamage>120% damage</style>, 5 a second. Each hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Gooed</style>. The blobs <style=cIsUtility>drop over distance</style> and lose damage past 20m (40% at 45m). 20-round magazine.

rows.name: Splatter
rows.description: <style=cIsUtility>Right Click</style> to aim (a goo dome shows the splash), <style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style> to lob a ball of goo that flies through enemies and splashes on the floor: <style=cIsDamage>200% damage</style> in 10m and <style=cIsUtility>3 Gooed</style>. It leaves an 8m <style=cIsUtility>goo puddle</style> for 10s that then shrinks away over 20s; it adds 1 Gooed a second to enemies standing in it and speeds up allies. <style=cIsUtility>No cooldown</style>: each throw costs <style=cIsDamage>5 rounds</style>; with fewer left the splash shrinks.

rows.name: The Cube
rows.description: Seal yourself in a goo cube for 3s: <style=cIsUtility>invulnerable</style> and frozen, sliding on with your momentum. Tar tethers latch onto the 4 nearest enemies within 13m, each draining <style=cIsDamage>100% damage per second</style> and <style=cIsHealing>healing you</style> for it. Then the cube bursts for <style=cIsDamage>600% damage</style> in 16m, <style=cIsUtility>maxing Gooed</style>, leaves a 10m <style=cIsUtility>goo puddle</style> like Splatter's, and you move 30% faster for 3s.

rows.name: Puddle Punch
rows.description: Place a giant goo fist anywhere within 40m (<style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style>): it punches up out of the ground for <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style> in 6m, <style=cIsUtility>knocking enemies up</style> and adding 2 Gooed. On a goo puddle it is <style=cIsUtility>twice as wide</style>. You and allies standing on it are <style=cIsUtility>bounced 20m into the air</style>. 2 charges.

rows.name: Goo Ball
rows.description: Become a huge ball of goo for 15s (+100 armor). Steer it, on the ground and in the air; it rolls faster downhill and bounces off walls. Smashing into enemies deals <style=cIsDamage>375-1500% damage</style> by speed, <style=cIsUtility>stuns</style>, launches them and maxes Gooed. Jump high (twice); landing slams for <style=cIsDamage>1125%</style> in 8m. Q again to stop.
